script.title: Piplup's Proud Little Wave
script.description: A round Piplup with bright oval eyes, a crown-shaped forehead marking, a projecting yellow bill, white chest buttons, webbed feet and one flipper lifted in greeting. Its dark-blue collar becomes a split cape on the back.
